question: Which of the following countries will host the ICC Women's International Cricket World Cup 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **India** has been selected to host the ICC Women's International Cricket World Cup in 2025.
 
• This will be the fifth time the ICC Women's World Cup will be held in India, with previous editions being hosted in 1978, 1997, 2013, and 2025.
 
• The decision was made by the International Cricket Council (ICC) during their annual conference.
 
• Hosting the tournament is a significant boost for women's cricket in India, reflecting the growing popularity and support for the sport in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International Cricket Council (ICC)**

 
 
• The ICC is the global governing body for cricket, responsible for organizing world cricket events such as the ICC Cricket World Cup, ICC T20 World Cup, and the ICC Champions Trophy.
 
• It was founded as the Imperial Cricket Conference in 1909 and was renamed the International Cricket Conference in 1965, before taking up its current name in 1989.
 
• The ICC's primary objective is to promote and develop the game of cricket globally.
 
• It also oversees the playing conditions, Code of Conduct, and other regulations of international cricket matches.
 
 
 
• **Women's Cricket World Cup**
 
 
• The ICC Women's Cricket World Cup is the premier international championship of women's cricket.
 
• The tournament was first held in 1973, making it the oldest world championship in women's cricket.
 
• It is held every four years and features teams from around the world competing for the prestigious title.
 
• Australia has been the most successful team, winning the tournament seven times as of 2023.
 
 
 
• **Cricket in India**
 
 
• Cricket is the most popular sport in India, with millions of fans and a strong following nationwide.
 
• The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) is the governing body for cricket in India and is one of the richest and most influential cricket boards in the world.
 
• India has produced many legendary cricketers, including Sachin Tendulkar, Virat Kohli, and Mithali Raj.
 
• The Indian Premier League (IPL), a professional Twenty20 cricket league, has further popularized the sport and attracted international attention.
